verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas runs a cloud-hosted Editor that automatically saves user work to its servers, so data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion controls or data-deletion policy. 'Project Archive and Restore' and Checkpoints are backup and versioning features, which are adjacent rather than retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
